scope: Per-symbol plain-language trend, momentum, volatility and headline research summary.
implementation: Deterministic presentation of the existing validated snapshot. No additional data requests, API changes, dependencies or model calls.

checks.live_browser_symbol_switch: AAPL -> MSFT; old summary cleared during load; distinct calculations and headlines displayed

browser.account: isolated synthetic account database and token; public market data
browser.source_numbers: SMA20/SMA50, simple RSI14, simple ATR14, historical close; derived distance from SMA20 and ATR/close percentage

limits: Headline relevance is a title-based symbol/name heuristic, not verified entity resolution.
Reading cues describe title topics; article bodies are not fetched or summarized. No causal price-move claims.
Market freshness, unknown candle intervals and event coverage remain unverified.
No trading signals or automated orders.
Backend/native tests not rerun for this frontend-only increment; full infrastructure, coverage gate and Windows runtime not tested.
